s1.quote: The wreck of Emmons lies in 147 feet (45 m) of water off Okinawa's Kouri Island.

s2.quote: sits at 138 feet at the bow and 150 feet at the stern on the seafloor

s3.quote: Diving at this depth should be accomplished by divers with some technical background … Live and unexploded ammunition is present, use caution when diving on the Emmons.

summary.text: A WWII destroyer-minesweeper lost to kamikaze attacks, resting at roughly 140-150 ft off Kouri Island, Okinawa. A deep boat dive for advanced or technical-trained divers, with live ordnance still aboard.
